title: NASA’s Chandra Breaks Down ‘Treble Clef’s’ Galaxy Cluster Collision
caption:
Deep in space, a giant radio wave 'Treble Clef' has been caught in the act. NASA researchers used X-ray telescopes to reveal it was caused by a supermassive black hole outburst and a massive galaxy cluster collision.

Source: Science - NASA’s Chandra Breaks Down ‘Treble Clef’s’ Galaxy Cluster Collision
